name: Val d'Orcia
description: Val d'Orcia is a stretch of rolling Tuscan countryside south of Siena, running toward Monte Amiata. Pale plains swell into rounded hills, many crowned by fortified villages such as Pienza, Radicofani and Montalcino, famed for its Brunello wine. Shaped by Siena in the 14th and 15th centuries as a picture of good governance, it has inspired artists ever since.
